name: @omnisaude/mobile
description: App Android (smartphones e tablets) do OmniSaúde, empacotado com Capacitor a partir do front-end web.

scripts.build:web: cd ../web && OMNI_STATIC_EXPORT=1 NEXT_DIST_DIR=out npx next build
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
